primary_indicator: joint (shock_type, internal_support), four cells; one selected check
primary_discrepancy: negative log posterior predictive probability of the 4-cell count histogram, n=12, including multinomial coefficient; mixture over one common H
tail: sum predictive probabilities of all histograms with discrepancy >= observed, exact enumeration
C0: new indicator unspecified, not zero; no new-feature rejection test
kernel: empirical confirmation frequencies within H; C+ exactly identical; no smoothing primary
sensitivity: Dirichlet(.5,.5,.5,.5) posterior on simulator cell probabilities within H, posterior predictive Dirichlet-multinomial; oracle probabilities benchmark only
document_fidelity: separate simulator fidelity diagnostic; not a newly discovered PPC because excluded by selector
exclusions: Unknown shock or decision excluded from frequency kernel and reported. If target any unknown, no PPC for that dataset. No selected-check replacement or additional test based on faults.
